# X360 Mobile 0.6.4 — Hotfix 2

This update brings general correctness, graphics, stability and efficiency improvements, developed and evaluated using **Split/Second** as a reference game. These are improvements to the emulator itself rather than fixes restricted to one title. Other games may also benefit, but broader compatibility and performance testing is still limited.

## Improvements

- Improved handling of demanding graphics workloads and reduced avoidable processing overhead.
- Corrected visual consistency and resource-handling issues, including an issue affecting frame interpolation.
- Improved the reliability of the touch-control layout editor.
- Added optional independent auto-hide for the Menu button.
- Reorganized Settings with fewer main categories and clearer access to game content, patches and advanced tools.

## Split/Second: still experimental

On the tested **Snapdragon 8 Gen 2** setup, Split/Second currently fluctuates around **8–18 FPS**, depending on the scene and the selected experimental settings. The game **still requires extensive further work to become playable on this SoC**. Occasional pauses and remaining graphical issues are still under investigation.

The experimental per-game options used for these tests remain **opt-in**; this update does not enable them globally. Results on other devices, drivers and games have not been widely verified.

## Updating

- Public version **0.6.4 Hotfix 2**, build **60411113**. Existing installations can update in place and keep their games, settings and saves.
- Includes the fixes from Hotfix 1. TV mode and synchronized player profiles remain highly experimental.
- X360 Companion is unchanged.
